notes: This contract pins the ordinary IEEE 1516.1-2025 declaration relevance advisories and their per-federate switch accessors to exact official C++ API surfaces. The development profile implements Start/Stop Registration For Object Class and Turn Interactions On/Off for ordinary publication/subscription transitions, with passive subscriptions excluded. The selected-file successful-void records for the four RTI-initiated callbacks and the two setter services are traced separately in mom-service-reporting-requirements-contract.json; generic MOM interaction delivery and interaction delivery remain outside this slice. Regional declaration advisories, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside the slice.
